pc_what.text: What does the failed check say?
pc_what.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Pre-Mission/Pre-Deploy Checks Failures

pc_reset.text: Run the reset the message names
steps: Run the reset the failure message suggests: !pbtreset or !brakereset.
pc_reset.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Pre-Mission/Pre-Deploy Checks Failures
pc_reset.help: The ! commands come up when you send them to yourself as a Slack direct message.

pc_wait.text: Wait 3 to 5 minutes, then re-run the checks
pc_wait.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Pre-Mission/Pre-Deploy Checks Failures
pc_wait.help: For pings that fail on a timeout, such as uptime TCM or Credentialer.

pc_drives.text: Deploy now, insert the drives before the mission
steps: You may tap Proceed Anyway to deploy without drives inserted.
Before starting the mission, insert the logging drives and make sure they pass the pre-mission readiness checks.
pc_drives.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Pre-Mission/Pre-Deploy Checks Failures
pc_drives.help: For logging checklists about missing drives during pre-deploy readiness checks.

steps: Run the !linkwidth steps. The cold start can wait until the deploy is finished.
You may tap Proceed Anyway to deploy with or without the drives inserted.
After the deploy, cold start and re-run the check.
pc_lw.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Pre-Mission/Pre-Deploy Checks Failures
pc_lw.help: For logger preflight check failures on PCIE Link Width. The ! commands come up when you send them to yourself as a Slack direct message.

pc_forvis.text: Checks are passing without VRE. Post a /vreforvis with the steps you took, a sysreport if possible, and how long you spent troubleshooting.
pc_forvis.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Purpose

pc_cs.text: Cold start, then re-run the checks
steps: Run the cold start steps for your platform: !coldstart (a579m), !volvocoldstart (asvat) or !a2cs (LTS).
pc_cs.source: TS: generic cold-start step, same as the other trees (VO site practice, Oct 2026). Added so operator options run out before escalating; the Dev Ops guide itself goes to VRE at this point.
pc_cs.help: The ! commands come up when you send them to yourself as a Slack direct message.

pc_esc_lw.phrase: PCIE Link Width still failing after !linkwidth and a cold start
details: This one also goes to HW Diagnostics and FAST.
pc_esc_lw.text: PCIE Link Width is still failing after !linkwidth and a cold start. Escalate to VRE, HW Diagnostics and FAST, and paste the handoff.
pc_esc_lw.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Pre-Mission/Pre-Deploy Checks Failures

details: Screenshot: the failed check and its message.
Attach a sysreport if you can.
pc_esc.text: The check is still failing. Escalate to VRE in a #vops_troubleshooting thread (Scout Troubleshooter, Aurora Mobile App, or /vrehelp) and paste the handoff.
pc_esc.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Purpose
